name: @pipeworx/mcp-sdmx-structure

tools.name: sdmx_dataflow_structure
tools.description: Get the structure of one dataflow from any SDMX 2.1 registry: its ordered dimensions and, for each, the valid codes with labels. This answers "what do the codes in dataflow X mean" and "what key do I need to pull data from it" — use it before calling a registry-specific get_data tool. Covers eurostat, oecd, ecb, unsd (UN Statistics Division via the data.un.org SDMX hub), imf, bis, ilo, abs. For ILO or ABS dataflows, prefer the ilostat/abs-au packs' own dataflow_structure tool — this one exists mainly for the other six. Example: sdmx_dataflow_structure({ registry: "eurostat", dataflow: "une_rt_m" }) or sdmx_dataflow_structure({ registry: "bis", dataflow: "WS_CBPOL" }).

registry.description: Which SDMX registry to query: eurostat, oecd, ecb, unsd, imf, bis, ilo, abs.

dataflow.description: Dataflow id, e.g. "une_rt_m" (Eurostat), "WS_CBPOL" (BIS), "EER" (IMF). Case usually does not matter but pass it exactly as published.

agency.description: Override the registry's default maintaining agency id, e.g. "OECD.SDD.NAD" for an OECD dataflow published by a specific directorate. Most callers can omit this.

max_codes_per_dimension.description: Cap codes returned per dimension (default 50, max 500). Codelists like country or region lists can have thousands of codes.

tools.name: sdmx_codelist
tools.description: Fetch one codelist's code->label mapping by id, from any SDMX 2.1 registry, without needing a dataflow. Use this when you already know a codelist id (e.g. from sdmx_dataflow_structure's `codelist` field, or from a dataset's documentation) and just need the codes. Example: sdmx_codelist({ registry: "ilo", id: "CL_ECO" }) or sdmx_codelist({ registry: "eurostat", id: "GEO", filter: "France" }).

registry.description: Which SDMX registry to query: eurostat, oecd, ecb, unsd, imf, bis, ilo, abs.

agency.description: Override the registry's default maintaining agency id for this codelist, e.g. "SDMX" for a shared CL_FREQ. Most callers can omit this.

filter.description: Case-insensitive substring filter on code id or label, e.g. "france", "quarterly".

tools.name: sdmx_find_dataflow
tools.description: Keyword-search a registry's full dataflow catalogue by id or name substring. Use this to find the dataflow id to pass to sdmx_dataflow_structure when you only know a topic. Example: sdmx_find_dataflow({ registry: "bis", query: "credit" }) or sdmx_find_dataflow({ registry: "oecd", query: "unemployment" }). For Eurostat specifically, the eurostat pack's own search_datasets tool searches its ~10,000-entry table of contents with richer metadata (last-update dates, time coverage) and is usually the better choice.

registry.description: Which SDMX registry to query: eurostat, oecd, ecb, unsd, imf, bis, ilo, abs.

query.description: Case-insensitive substring to match against dataflow id or name, e.g. "unemployment", "credit", "exchange rate".

agency.description: Restrict to one maintaining agency id instead of the registry default, e.g. "OECD.SDD.NAD".

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-sdmx-structure forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the sdmx-structure pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
